verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a dedicated Agentic Feed API that lets merchants upload product data in batches of up to 200 items. That data is mapped and synchronized to AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta, and one item can target several platforms in a single request. Marketing material adds that a single feed adapts to each platform and carries real-time catalog and inventory data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the feed works in practice, and detail on the feed schema and data mapping.
